facebook.content:
“Therefore the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.” – 1 Cor 4:20  

The Kingdom moves when we step out in authority, not when we linger in debate. Jesus reigns over every circumstance; His power is activated the moment we claim it for His glory.  

What area of your life will you surrender to Kingdom power today?

instagram.content:
“**His kingdom is not a matter of talk — it is a matter of power.**  
Matthew 12:28 — ‘But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, … the kingdom of God has come upon you.’  

The Kingdom moves when we submit to His authority, not when we debate it. Every decision you make today either opens the throne room or shuts the door.  

What Kingdom‑power are you releasing right now?​
